atoms.text: At school, Nina, Richard and Meera are given a recipe. It could make 1 cake, 10 cupcakes, or 10 brownies.

instruction.text: Nina wants to make 2 cakes. How much of each ingredient should she use?

hint.text: To make 2 cakes, Nina needs to double all the ingredients.

instruction.text: Richard wants to make 15 cupcakes. How much of each ingredient should he use?

hint.text: To make 15 cupcakes, Richard needs to halve the recipe and triple the amount.

instruction.text: Meera wants to make 40 brownies. How much of each ingredient should she use?

hint.text: For 40 brownies, Meera needs to use four times the amount of each ingredient.
